_doc: The 8 mm slot of the 40 mm series as European sellers stock it ("I-type", made to match item's Line 8), for unbranded stock: the figures one named seller's CAD outline gives (KJN), agreeing with a second seller's drawing where that prints one (Dold Mechatronik). Far-East "4040" stock has thinner lips under the same name: about 2 mm against 4.5 (Systeal's and Spool3D's drawings). Every figure is community: measure the bar you have. The drawn slot leaves out the small step at the mouth and the V groove in the floor, and draws the rounded flanks as straight ones at 45 degrees.
name: slot-8-i

opening.rule: Between the lips: 8 in KJN's outline, "8,0 + 0,4 mm" at Dold. Unbranded stock differs from seller to seller: measure yours
opening.source: KJN Aluminium Profile, DXF of part IR02633 (40x40L), https://www.aluminium-profile.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/downloadfiles/DXF_Files/ITM%20PROFILES/8mm%20Slot/40X40L%20ITM02633.DXF

lip_thickness.rule: From the face to the lip's underside, in KJN's outline (Dold dimensions none). Unbranded stock differs from seller to seller: measure yours
lip_thickness.source: KJN Aluminium Profile, DXF of part IR02633 (40x40L), https://www.aluminium-profile.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/downloadfiles/DXF_Files/ITM%20PROFILES/8mm%20Slot/40X40L%20ITM02633.DXF

cavity_width.rule: Width under the lips, in KJN's outline. Unbranded stock differs from seller to seller: measure yours
cavity_width.source: KJN Aluminium Profile, DXF of part IR02633 (40x40L), https://www.aluminium-profile.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/downloadfiles/DXF_Files/ITM%20PROFILES/8mm%20Slot/40X40L%20ITM02633.DXF

cavity_depth.rule: From the face to the floor: KJN's outline and Dold's drawing agree. Unbranded stock differs from seller to seller: measure yours
cavity_depth.source: KJN Aluminium Profile, DXF of part IR02633 (40x40L), https://www.aluminium-profile.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/downloadfiles/DXF_Files/ITM%20PROFILES/8mm%20Slot/40X40L%20ITM02633.DXF

floor_width.rule: Width of the flat floor in KJN's outline, which reaches it by two arcs and a short 45 degree flat. Unbranded stock differs from seller to seller: measure yours
floor_width.source: KJN Aluminium Profile, DXF of part IR02633 (40x40L), https://www.aluminium-profile.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/downloadfiles/DXF_Files/ITM%20PROFILES/8mm%20Slot/40X40L%20ITM02633.DXF

flank_angle.rule: The flanks close in at 45 degrees between their arcs, in KJN's outline
flank_angle.source: KJN Aluminium Profile, DXF of part IR02633 (40x40L), https://www.aluminium-profile.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/downloadfiles/DXF_Files/ITM%20PROFILES/8mm%20Slot/40X40L%20ITM02633.DXF

nut_family.rule: Sold with "slot 8 I-type" nuts; not the B-type nuts of the 30 mm series
nut_family.source: KJN Aluminium Profile, DXF of part IR02633 (40x40L), https://www.aluminium-profile.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/downloadfiles/DXF_Files/ITM%20PROFILES/8mm%20Slot/40X40L%20ITM02633.DXF
